description: Central Provincial Council - Notify the Entertainment Tax Waththegama Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the imposition of an entertainment tax within the Waththegama Urban Council. It references specific ordinances and acts (Entertainment Tax Ordinance chapter 267, Urban Council act chapter 255, Entertainment Tax Ordinance No. 12 of 1946, entertainment tax act No. 37 of 1984) and outlines regulatory procedures for tax implementation. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with tax regulations and statutory instruments rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
